skills.name: bin-sort-divert
skills.task: Pick a classified workpiece from the staging nest, rotate shoulder to the divert chute, release, and return to ready stance.

skills.name: cable-connector-insert
skills.task: Seat a gripped electrical or data plug into a receptacle socket, release, and disengage.

skills.name: calibration-pose-sweep
skills.task: Drive through the calibration capture poses and hold at each one, so joint zeros and camera extrinsics can be re-measured after §45.4 expires them.

skills.name: conveyor-place-return
skills.task: Carry the held part from the buffer stance back over the conveyor centerline, set it down on the belt, release, and lift clear.

skills.name: conveyor-transfer-pick
skills.task: Acquire an indexed part from the moving conveyor belt centerline, lift vertically, and transition to buffer stance.

skills.name: door-latch-open
skills.task: Engage a door lever handle, depress downward to unlatch, push door open along its swing arc, and retreat.

skills.name: gripper-cycle-check
skills.task: Cycle the gripper through its full travel three times at the carry pose, so a gripper that has stopped reaching either end is found at a bench rather than over a workpiece.

skills.name: handoff-receive
skills.task: Take the workpiece from the operator's hand at the handoff pose and retreat to the carry pose holding it.

skills.name: joint-range-check
skills.task: Walk each joint through a bounded excursion and back, so a servo that has stopped tracking is found before a shift rather than during one.

skills.name: palletize-box-stack
skills.task: Pick a boxed item from conveyor height, slew to pallet layer, deposit squarely, and retreat.

skills.name: park
skills.task: Fold the arm into the cell's safe parking pose and stop there.

skills.name: payload-droop-check
skills.task: Hold the loaded arm at full reach for twenty seconds and stop there, so a drive that no longer holds its payload is measured rather than inferred from a dropped part.

skills.name: photo-turntable
skills.task: Present the held workpiece to a fixed camera at six taught orientations, holding three seconds at each, then return to the carry pose.

skills.name: pick-fixtured
skills.task: Pick the workpiece out of the declared fixture and retreat to the carry pose.

skills.name: place-fixtured
skills.task: Put the held workpiece back into the declared fixture and retreat empty-handed.

skills.name: present
skills.task: Move to the operator handoff pose, open the gripper, and hold there for loading.

skills.name: push-button-actuate
skills.task: Depress a physical control panel or cycle-start push button with a rigid finger and retreat.

skills.name: scale-retrieve
skills.task: Descend from the scale hover to the check-weigher platen, re-grasp the weighed workpiece, lift back to hover holding it.

skills.name: shift-readiness
skills.task: Hold for thirty seconds while the OS decides whether this robot is fit to start a shift, so a robot that is not refuses here and names the reason instead of failing over a workpiece.

skills.name: surface-wipe-pass
skills.task: Execute a smooth planar surface wiping pass across the designated work area and lift clear.

skills.name: thermal-scan-arc
skills.task: Sweep an inspection sensor or thermal pyrometer along a 180-degree radial arc around the workpiece.

skills.name: tool-rack-dock
skills.task: Guide attached tool into the quick-change tool rack receiver, disengage mechanical lock, and retreat rearward.

skills.name: tool-rack-pick
skills.task: Approach the quick-change tool rack receiver, close on the staged tool, extract along the dock axis, and return to centered carry holding it.

skills.name: weigh-scale-deposit
skills.task: Place held workpiece onto in-line check-weigher scale platen, release grip, dwell for tare reading, and hover ready for re-grasp.
